Independent reverse search, complete rank-six enumeration and direct word evaluation
correctness.rationale: Independently filtered all 8^8 maps by rank, selected the least lexicographically packed cyclic conjugate, and used reverse preimage BFS from all singletons. The full set is reached at depth k exactly when some word of length k resets; the empty preimage is a dead state. This reproduced all 31 rows in the frozen CSV and RESULT.md, 5362560 labeled maps, 670608 classes and 2304 half-turn-fixed maps. The latter have orbits of size four; other stabilizers are excluded because the rank-six image cannot be a union of orbits of size four or eight. A constant word cannot commute with the fixed-point-free half-turn. The sole length-36 representative is 01234017; direct evaluation confirms the supplied 36-letter word ends at 0. The mean is 3322203/331840 and exactly seven classes have length at least 29. Replay: /workspace/review-check-1.py and /workspace/review-check-1.log; the frozen C++ and Python checked by inspection, not executed.
residual_risks: Only the stated eight-state family, with the specified distinguished letters and conjugations, is verified.
